import ctypes
import numpy as np
from numpy.ctypeslib import ndpointer

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define ctypes function prototypes
# gsl_eigen_genherm_workspace *gsl_eigen_genherm_alloc(const size_t n);
gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]

# void gsl_eigen_genherm_free(gsl_eigen_genherm_workspace *w);
gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm_free.restype = None
gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]

# int gsl_eigen_genherm(gsl_matrix_complex *A, gsl_matrix_complex *B, gsl_vector *eval, gsl_eigen_genherm_workspace *w);
gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm.restype = ctypes.c_int
gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]

# gsl_matrix_complex *gsl_matrix_complex_alloc(const size_t n1, const size_t n2);
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]

# void gsl_matrix_complex_free(gsl_matrix_complex *m);
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free.restype = None
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]

gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]

# gsl_vector *gsl_vector_alloc(const size_t n);
gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

# double gsl_vector_get(const gsl_vector *v, const size_t i);
gsl.gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t]

# Helper functions to convert NumPy arrays to GSL-compatible ctypes structures
def numpy_to_gsl_matrix_complex(np_array):
    rows, cols = np_array.shape
    matrix = gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc(rows, cols)
    if not matrix:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate GSL matrix.")
    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_set(matrix, i, j, np_array[i, j].real, np_array[i, j].imag)
    return matrix

def gsl_vector_to_numpy(gsl_vector, size):
    np_array = np.zeros(size, dtype=np.float64)
    for i in range(size):
        np_array[i] = gsl.gsl_vector_get(gsl_vector, i)
    return np_array

# Main function to compute eigenvalues
def compute_eigenvalues(A, B):
    if A.shape != B.shape or A.shape[0] != A.shape[1]:
        raise ValueError("Matrices A and B must be square and of the same dimensions.")

    n = A.shape[0]

    # Allocate workspace
    workspace = gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm_alloc(n)
    if not workspace:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate GSL workspace.")

    try:
        # Convert matrices to GSL format
        gsl_A = numpy_to_gsl_matrix_complex(A)
        gsl_B = numpy_to_gsl_matrix_complex(B)

        # Allocate vector for eigenvalues
        gsl_eval = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(n)
        if not gsl_eval:
            raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate GSL vector.")

        try:
            # Call the GSL function
            status = gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm(gsl_A, gsl_B, gsl_eval, workspace)
            if status != 0:
                raise RuntimeError("GSL function gsl_eigen_genherm failed with status code {}.".format(status))

            # Convert eigenvalues back to NumPy
            eigenvalues = gsl_vector_to_numpy(gsl_eval, n)

            return eigenvalues

        finally:
            gsl.gsl_vector_free(gsl_eval)
            gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free(gsl_A)
            gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free(gsl_B)

    finally:
        gsl.gsl_eigen_genherm_free(workspace)

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Simple 2x2 matrices
    A = np.array([[1+1j, 2+2j], [2-2j, 3+3j]], dtype=np.complex128)
    B = np.array([[1+0j, 0+0j], [0+0j, 1+0j]], dtype=np.complex128)
    eigenvalues = compute_eigenvalues(A, B)
    assert len(eigenvalues) == 2, "Test case 1 failed: Incorrect number of eigenvalues."

    # Test case 2: Identity matrices
    A = np.eye(3, dtype=np.complex128)
    B = np.eye(3, dtype=np.complex128)
    eigenvalues = compute_eigenvalues(A, B)
    assert np.allclose(eigenvalues, [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]), "Test case 2 failed."

    # Test case 3: Error handling for non-square matrices
    try:
        A = np.array([[1+1j, 2+2j]], dtype=np.complex128)
        B = np.array([[1+0j, 0+0j]], dtype=np.complex128)
        compute_eigenvalues(A, B)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "Matrices A and B must be square and of the same dimensions.", "Test case 3 failed."

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
